# Project Guidelines

This is a fork of an upstream project.

This is an app which functions as an overlay for streaming a racing wheel gamepad on PC. It connects to a G920 Racing Wheel or any steering wheel gamepad and shows a visual representation of the controls.

My fork is for **personal use**. I will tailor it to my needs with no upstream merge intentions. Please refrain from PRs or issues.

Project will be extended completely agentically, ensure code is clean and maintainable.

## Commit Messages

- When creating commits in this repository, follow the post-fork commit style used on `master`.
- Prefer Conventional Commit subjects with a lowercase type prefix and a concise imperative summary.
- Use formats like `refactor: ...`, `docs: ...`, `feat: ...`, `lint: ...`, `chore: ...`, and `fix: ...` unless the user asks for a different convention.
- Keep the subject focused on the primary change and match the tone of recent commits such as `refactor: migrate to vite` and `docs: update README.md`.
